title: Global constructibility from affine-local constructibility
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning that it admits a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring. Choose either the small étale site or the small pro-étale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of modules over the constant ring sheaf $\underline R_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an immersion $i:Z\to X$, write $F|_Z=i^{-1}F$ with constant coefficients [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Say that this restriction is locally constant with finitely presented values if it has a covering on the chosen site of $Z$ on each member $V$ of which it is isomorphic to the constant module sheaf $\underline M_V$, for some finitely presented $R$-module $M$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. The module $M$ may vary with $V$ and need not be finite as a set.

The following conditions are equivalent: (i) for every affine open $U\subseteq X$, there is a finite stratification $U=\coprod_a Z_a$ [def-constructible-stratification] by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset], such that each $F|_{Z_a}$ is locally constant with finitely presented values; (ii) there is one finite stratification $X=\coprod_b S_b$ by constructible locally closed subschemes such that each $F|_{S_b}$ is locally constant with finitely presented values. The equivalence holds separately for either choice of site, with no finiteness assumption on the underlying set of $R$.
